test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 2 Feb 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A 280 m long train is running at a speed of 54 km/h. In how much time (in seconds) will it cross a man moving at 12 km/h in the same direction as that of the train?
solution:
**Given:**

Length of the train = 280 m

Speed of the train = 54 km/h

Speed of the man = 12 km/h

**Concept used:**

Time = Distance/speed

When two bodies move in the same direction, their relative speed is computed by their difference.

If a train cross a man/pole/tree then it will cover only its own length.

**Calculation:**

Relative speed of the train and the man = (54 - 12) = 42 km/h

Speed in m/sec = 42 × (5/18)

⇒ 35/3 m/sec

Time = 280 ÷ (35/3)

⇒ 280 × (3/35)

⇒ 24 sec

**∴ It will cross the man in 24 seconds.**
